methodology.primary_baseline: T1, top_p1; coding low, reasoning high, other none; budgets 12288/4096/2048
methodology.quality_concurrency: Up to four mixed-profile requests; long-context requests singly. Both arms share one server.
methodology.first_token: First nonempty content/reasoning/tool delta, not first SSE frame
methodology.first_answer: First nonempty final-content/tool delta; separate from reasoning
methodology.speed: Per-category fixed selection prompt, 1024 output-token cap; 4 warmups per arm; C1/C4, five alternating paired batches per workload. Completion tokens include reasoning; divided by batch wall time including TTFT. Warm-prefix tests; no cache flush.
methodology.seed_note: Supplied seeds are paired; backend deterministic inference is not enabled.
methodology.selection_ties: Higher pass rate, fewer truncations, baseline first, then lower budget/effort/temperature closest to one
methodology.smoke_gate: API completion, nonzero usage and thinking-mode effectiveness; wrong answers are retained, not startup failures
limitations: Synthetic tasks, not an official benchmark or real production traffic
Only 21 problem families: seven selection and fourteen holdout; instances within a family are correlated
Format compliance is not semantic correctness
More thinking tokens can change token/s without improving useful final output; latency and first-answer time reported separately

continuation.reason: Unique per-invocation Docker names prevent concurrent identical-code grading from sharing a container. Added provenance and cooperative checkpoint stopping. Model requests, fixtures, selected profiles and acceptance gates unchanged.
continuation.stop_method: Paused at the next status-write checkpoint after every active request was saved; no model generation was interrupted and no completed score was replaced.
continuation.resume_order: The documented runner reshuffles only remaining tasks using its fixed seed; actual concurrency is recorded per observation.
